tool_args.rationale: The pilot labels (sigmoidal inflection onset, sink-gradient C2) and controlled feature set support a smooth inhibited response, but do not settle the branch contribution under the single horizon. Acquire the specified low-cost branch-discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows vary both u_now and s_grad and cover only a single common horizon; the four-parameter Hill law can be fitted, but no fresh confirmation is available and the archive explicitly calls for an open-branch probe when s_grad span is below 0.08.
This is aimed at trajectory/memory ODE ambiguity and costs more; the pilot indicates a sigmoidal onset with sink-gradient dependence, not a trajectory signature.
Irrelevant auxiliary measurement and explicitly not worth its cost.
